decision: Wire four minimal shims onto the T-0140 infrastructure: (A) resolveActorTenant helper (src/db/org.ts) resolves actor slug → tenant UUID via BYPASSRLS SELECT on choros.employee, injected into listOrgTree/findEmployeeById/listHumanEmployees with DEV_TENANT_ID fallback when DB absent or actor unknown — zero public-signature changes to frozen exports; (B) pack-file-serve path in rights.ts and processes.ts reads seed/showcase/pack.json rights_cards and process_instances when DATABASE_URL is set, falling back to RIGHTS_SEED/PROCESSES_SEED when DB is absent; (C) seed apply is run as a documented one-time operational step (idempotent, AC-17/FR-1); (D) DEMO_TENANT_SLUG env var (default: showcase) resolves the pre-login /api/users tenant scope. Agent personas excluded (Option A, FR-7). AC-12 founder note preserved.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Changes API surface consumed by frozen e2e tests and React frontend; caller-controlled tenant enables cross-tenant leakage (AC-13 violation)
Single-tenant assumption breaks multi-tenant-first data model (T-0013); showcase tenant must be actor-scoped, not process-level

rejected_alternatives.option: New DB table demo_personas for picker config
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Over-engineered; DEMO_TENANT_SLUG env + listHumanEmployees query achieves the same result in three lines (rubric axis 5 proportionality)
Spec §4 out-of-scope item 5 explicitly preserves in-memory fallbacks; T-0140 I-2 designates them as the single permitted second locus; FF-FALLBACK-6 enforces retention

rejected_alternatives.option: Runtime JSON Schema re-validation of pack on every request
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Expensive per-request overhead; pack is immutable in a running process; validation is CI-time (T-0140 FF-1); runtime load is lazy-cached

rejected_alternatives.option: Add agent employees to /api/users (Option B, FR-7)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Spec explicitly selects Option A (minimal); any change requires founder product-direction call; AC-12 note preserved in acceptance walkthrough

contracts: GET /api/org — unchanged signature; behavior: when DATABASE_URL set, actor tenant resolved via resolveActorTenant(actorSlug); fallback to DEV_TENANT_ID when DB absent. Response: { departments: OrgDepartment[] }

GET /api/users — unchanged signature; behavior: when DATABASE_URL set, tenant resolved from DEMO_TENANT_SLUG env (default: showcase) via resolveTenantBySlug; returns human employees only (kind='human'). Response: { users: Array<{id, name, position, department}> }

GET /api/rights — when DATABASE_URL set: loads seed/showcase/pack.json, returns { roles: pack.rights_cards[] } with role_slug mapped to id; when DB absent: returns RIGHTS_SEED. Response shape: { roles: Role[] } — identical envelope to current

GET /api/processes — when DATABASE_URL set: loads seed/showcase/pack.json, returns { instances: pack.process_instances[] }; when DB absent: returns PROCESSES_SEED. Response shape: { instances: ProcessInstance[] } — identical envelope to current

findEmployee(employeeId: string): Promise<(OrgPerson & { position: string; department: string }) | null> — FROZEN SIGNATURE (src/http/org.ts:130). Internal change: calls resolveActorTenant(pool, employeeId) before findEmployeeById. No external signature change.

listSelectableUsers(): Promise<Array<{id, name, position, department}>> — FROZEN SIGNATURE (src/http/org.ts:160). Internal change: uses resolveTenantBySlug(pool, DEMO_TENANT_SLUG) instead of DEV_TENANT_ID. No external signature change.
registerOrgRoutes(router: Router, _store?: JobStore): void — FROZEN SIGNATURE (src/http/org.ts:192). Unchanged.

resolveActorTenant(pool: Pool, actorSlug: string): Promise<string> — new internal helper in src/db/org.ts. Query: SELECT e.tenant_id FROM choros.employee WHERE slug=$1 LIMIT 1 (no GUC, pool is BYPASSRLS). Returns DEV_TENANT_ID if not found or DATABASE_URL absent.

resolveTenantBySlug(pool: Pool, tenantSlug: string): Promise<string> — new internal helper in src/db/org.ts. Query: SELECT id FROM choros.tenant WHERE slug=$1 LIMIT 1 (no GUC, BYPASSRLS). Returns DEV_TENANT_ID if not found.

loadShowcasePack(packDir?: string): Pack — new thin module src/http/pack-serve.ts. Reads and parses seed/showcase/pack.json synchronously. No runtime schema validation (CI-time only). Cached after first load.

fitness_functions.rule: seed apply on clean migrated DB exits 0; GET /api/org returns 3 depts/7 positions/12 employees; GET /api/rights returns 8 role cards; GET /api/processes returns 8 instances. Self-test: a deliberate wrong-count assertion must exit non-zero.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/seed-apply-smoke.sh — runs node seed/cli.js apply, then curl-asserts counts; includes SELF-TEST block with wrong expected value. Wired in npm run seed:smoke under fitness:db CI gate (requires DATABASE_URL). Covers AC-1/AC-2/AC-3/AC-11/AC-18.

fitness_functions.rule: Pack-file-serve path returns correct counts when DATABASE_URL set: GET /api/rights → 8 role cards, GET /api/processes → 8 instances. Self-test: wrong-pack path must return non-zero exit.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/pack-serve-counts.sh — starts server with DATABASE_URL and CHOROS_PACK_DIR pointing at test fixture; asserts counts; includes SELF-TEST block (random free port, no collision). Always-on CI (no live DB needed with test fixture). Covers FR-9/FR-10/AC-11/AC-18.

fitness_functions.rule: Cross-tenant isolation: GET /api/org with X-Dev-User of a showcase employee must not return departments from DEV_TENANT_ID. Self-test: DEV_TENANT_ID dept slug must not appear in response.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/no-cross-tenant-org.sh — live-DB gate (fitness:db); asserts showcase dept slugs present and known DEV_TENANT_ID dept slugs absent. Covers AC-13/NF-4.

fitness_functions.rule: Display-plane serve modules (src/http/pack-serve.ts, rights.ts, processes.ts) must not import pg or any src/db/* module. No DB writes from the display-plane path.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/pack-serve-no-write.sh — grep -E "from ['\"](pg|.*src/db)" src/http/pack-serve.ts src/http/rights.ts src/http/processes.ts; any match = non-zero exit. Always-on CI. Covers I-1 exception fence / T-0140 FF-7.

fitness_functions.rule: Frozen exports findEmployee, listSelectableUsers, registerOrgRoutes in src/http/org.ts retain their pre-T-0141 parameter signatures.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/frozen-exports.sh — grep -n 'export.*findEmployee\|export.*listSelectableUsers\|export.*registerOrgRoutes' src/http/org.ts must match exactly 3 lines with the baseline signatures. Always-on CI. Covers FE-W23-0008.

fitness_functions.rule: When DATABASE_URL is absent, GET /api/org, GET /api/users, GET /api/rights, GET /api/processes all return 200 with non-empty data from in-memory seeds.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/no-db-fallback.sh — starts server without DATABASE_URL; curls all four endpoints; asserts 200 + non-empty array in each response. Always-on CI. Covers NF-1 / spec §4.5 fallback retention.

fitness_functions.rule: resolveActorTenant and resolveTenantBySlug function bodies in src/db/org.ts must not contain the literal DEV_TENANT_ID UUID (a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001) inline — fallback allowed only via DEV_TENANT_ID constant reference.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/no-hardcoded-tenant.sh — extracts the two function bodies from src/db/org.ts and greps for the literal UUID; any match = non-zero exit. Always-on CI. Covers AC-13 / T-0013 isolation invariant.

fitness_functions.rule: Every ci/checks/demo/*.sh script must contain a SELF-TEST marker comment followed by an assertion that verifies the check can detect regressions (i.e., at least one deliberately-failing probe that must produce non-zero exit).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/demo/self-test-presence.sh — greps each ci/checks/demo/*.sh for the literal string '# SELF-TEST:'; any script missing the marker = non-zero exit. Always-on CI. Covers all FF checks.
